The '''Algnadesh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was a part of the [[Rifle Worlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions. The system was connected to the [[Wodan system/Legends|Wodan system]] by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA" /> and shared its name with the [[Algnadesh Ship Graveyards]], a legendary collection of disappeared [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|20|Algnadesh Ship Graveyards}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Algnadesh system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
